name: Iori
message: 「...Suzakuin Momiji, huh. What am I gonna do with her?」
From talking to her, she seemed pretty guarded and tough to crack.
It's my first time dealing with someone from the Suzakuin family, but are they all like that?
If she's just not warmed up to me yet since we've only just met, that's fine, but if she acts like that toward the other students too, it could be a bit of a problem.

name: Iori
message: 「She's going to the academy and all, so I'd really like her to enjoy herself more.」
Going your own way is fine and all, but that's a teaching of Jindou—everyday life is a different story.
Because otherwise, it'd just be too lonely.

name: Iori
message: 「Putting that aside, there's also the Jindou side of things to worry about.」
Suzakuin Momiji undeniably possesses extraordinary skill.
Still, she probably can't beat Tennouji Victoria-san when she gets serious. As things stand, she'll end up in tears at the Martial Festival.
As someone entrusted with being her assistant homeroom teacher, I can't just sit back and let that happen.

name: Iori
message: 「I really want to help her out somehow...」
As I walked along, mulling over all sorts of things like that.
I reached for the hilt of my Origami and swiftly thumbed the guard loose.
Then, toward the ominous presence rapidly closing in from above and behind me, I unleashed a sure-hit blade in the manner of <d0091>Iai</d>—

name: Iori
message: 「Oww！？」
Something large and soft slamming straight into me.
A gentle floral scent drifted around me, enveloping me as I lay sprawled on the ground.
「It's been a long time, Iori-san.」
The one who had just pulled off a full-speed dive straight at me was Kuki Asahi-chan.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ah, to think I'd get to see you again like this, Iori-san... I'm so moved!」

name: Iori
message: 「Jumping at someone from behind is dangerous, you know！ I almost cut you down！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, if I were to die by your blade, Iori-san, I'd have no regrets.」

name: Iori
message: 「Give me a break. Are you trying to turn me into a criminal...？」
The instant I turned around, the sight that filled my vision was a girl throwing herself at me completely defenseless.
I'd hurriedly sheathed my blade and managed to catch her, which was fine up to that point, but the momentum sent me tumbling to the ground.

name: Asahi
message: 「If you killed me and became a criminal, Iori-san, that would essentially mean I've taken complete control of your life, wouldn't it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Depending on how you look at it, maybe that's not such a bad idea？」

name: Iori
message: 「It is a bad idea, so come back to your senses, okay?」
Asahi-chan's turned into quite a weird kid in the short time I haven't seen her...
I first met Asahi-chan back when she had only just started elementary school.
She was quiet, sweet, and considerate—a really good kid. She took a liking to me, and I have memories of playing together with her.
Several years since then. Asahi had grown into a fine young woman.

name: Iori
message: 「How've you been, Asahi？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, as you can see, I was able to enroll at Murakumo Academy without any trouble. I'm currently a first-year in the Martial Arts Division.」

name: Iori
message: 「You just started this year? Congrats！ Man, you've really grown.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Reuniting like this must be some kind of fate. I look forward to being in your care again.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course.」

name: Iori
message: 「Though, there's just one thing I've been wondering about.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And what might that be?」

name: Iori
message: 「Just how long are you planning to stay straddling me？」
People around us have been giving us weird looks for a while now.

name: Asahi
message: 「Expressing the joy of a reunion through close, intimate physical contact is a modern custom, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「I've never heard of any custom like that？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「What's the harm? We finally reunited, after all. I want to look at you up close a little longer, Iori.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm happy to see you too, but this position is kind of bad, don't you think...？」

name: Asahi
message: 「If it's alright with you, Iori, I'm quite willing to consummate our union as man and woman right here.」

name: Iori
message: 「What are you saying？ Hey, what are you even saying？！」
We're not getting anywhere like this. I place my hands on Asahi's waist to lift her up.

name: Asahi
message: 「Ahn... That feels good.」

name: Iori
message: 「H-Hey, stop making weird noises！」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's impossible.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Letting out cries of ecstasy whenever you touch me, Iori—it's simply a law of nature at this point.」

name: Iori
message: 「Okay, got it, I won't touch you anymore. Just stand up on your own, please.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You're telling me to abandon this honeymoon of my own accord？ How could you say something so cruel...！」
...Wait, is she just having fun teasing me？

name: Iori
message: 「That's enough—hyaaaah！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Kyaahn...」
I pushed Asahi-chan off and forced myself to my feet.

name: Asahi
message: 「Honestly, you're so forceful... Still, I find that side of you wonderful too, Iori-san」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, let's avoid phrasing things in a way that invites misunderstandings」

name: Asahi
message: 「How did it feel to lift my body？」

name: Iori
message: 「Th-That you're really well-trained, I guess」
It felt different from a man's body and made my heart race, though I'll keep that to myself. Yeah.

name: Asahi
message: 「Still, what a surprise. Why are you at the academy, Iori-san？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I had heard you were in the <d0092>JGSDF Special Forces</d>, though」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I am. I came here on a mission」
I briefly explain the situation to Asahi-chan.

name: Asahi
message: 「I see, brought in on a special appointment dispatch as assistant homeroom teacher for Takamura Class...」
Asahi-chan, deep in thought about something.

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood, I will deal with it at once」

name: Iori
message: 「W-With what？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, it's a personal matter, so please pay it no mind」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, why the sudden tackle just now？」
I get that she was happy to see me again, but there was no need to pounce on me out of nowhere.

name: Asahi
message: 「That couldn't be helped」

name: Asahi
message: 「I was walking through the academy when, for some reason, you—the Iori-san I'd been longing to see—were right in front of me」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, I know of no option other than throwing myself at you」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I see, well, if that's the case, it can't be helped...」
Asahi-chan really is a bit of an odd girl after all.

name: Asahi
message: 「...You're a cruel person, Iori-san」

name: Asahi
message: 「Once you graduated from the academy alongside my brother, I completely lost all contact with you, Iori-san」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even when I sent letters, I never heard a word back. I was worried about you, you know」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah... Sorry I didn't keep in touch.」
After joining the JGSDF, I was tied up with basic training for a while, and even after that I was flying all over the country for Tenju Special Forces Group training and missions.
Still, it's true that I used being busy as an excuse to put off replying.

name: Asahi
message: 「Could it be that you're still bothered about my brother？」
At her words, I involuntarily lowered my gaze.

name: Iori
message: 「...Is your brother—is Takahisa doing well？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, he's doing quite well.」

name: Asahi
message: 「He's as flashy and loud-mouthed a party boy as ever—so unbearably annoying that it makes me want to let him sleep nice and soundly inside a giant bucket.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Well, I'm glad to hear that.」
<d0028>Kuki Takahisa</d>―her older brother―was my best friend back in our academy days.
A lot happened and we aren't in touch anymore, but hearing that he hasn't changed since our academy days made me feel a little relieved.

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm really glad to see you haven't changed either, Iori-san. You'll be teaching here at the academy from now on, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's the plan.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, as your number-one disciple, Iori-san, I'm really looking forward to what's ahead.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hold on, my 'number-one disciple'？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Back when I was in elementary school, you're the one who guided me through the basics of Jindou every step of the way, Iori-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am who I am today because you taught me so earnestly back then.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, right—that did happen, didn't it！」
Back when Asahi-chan was in elementary school, she had only just started Jindou, so I gave her all sorts of advice.
Maybe that made her happy, because she kept coming to see me over and over, and every time she did, I taught her the ABCs of Jindou.

name: Asahi
message: 「Getting into Murakumo Academy like this is all thanks to you, Iori-san. I'm truly grateful.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not true at all. Getting in here is the result of your own hard work, Asahi-chan.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Either way, from now on I'll be able to see you every day here at the academy, Iori-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'll usually be with Takamura Class, but you can come see me anytime after school.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, I'm looking forward to it!」
Saying that, Asahi-chan broke into a genuinely happy smile.
